system.description:
Starting, at 10th level, you learn additional Flurry techniques that without your Primal Weapon, you otherwise would be unable to even fathom.

Elemental Mark. As a bonus action, you can spend 1 Discipline to mark a creature you can see within 60 feet of you with an Elemental Mark. A special Fuinjutsu seal designed to be perceived by you and you alone. You can sense them as if they were an elemental effect. A creature is marked until you mark another creature, it dies, or it leaves your sensory range, after which the mark dispels itself. When a marked creature attempts to a cast a jutsu, it can trigger an attack of opportunity from you. If you do, you can instead cast a Ninjutsu you know in place of an attack made as a part of your attack of opportunity.

Primal break. Once per turn, when you cast a Bukijutsu with a nature release keyword of the same type as your Primal Weapon you can spend 2 Discipline turning its range into a Self (20-foot radius).

Chakra Network Overload. When you deal [Weapon Damage] with your Primal Weapon, you can spend 3 Discipline in an attempt to overwhelm the targets chakra network. One affected creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they take chakra damage equal to your [Weapon Damage] plus the bonus damage from the Chakra Strike Flurry technique at no additional Discipline cost and any concentration check they make as part of taking this damage is made at disadvantage.
